text:
maria: heads-up — canary push to eu-west failed to promote. Deploybot rejected manifest with a provenance check.

maria: deploybot log:
```
deploybot: promotion blocked for image=registry.aws/redwood/service:sha256:abc123
reason=cosign: attestation timestamp 2024-12-01T12:00:00Z older than allowed signing threshold
status=REJECTED
``` 

kevin: got it. do we know if this is a stale cosign key or replication delay? :thinking:

deploybot: system: policy 'provenance-ttl' rejected artifact; recommended actions: retag+re-sign OR pin known-good digest to stable channel.

tanvi: recommendation — don't roll forward the canary. Pin prod to last stable digest (sha256:def456) and re-run build pipeline to retag+re-attest. We'll need a short change window for retag to avoid duplicate tags.

ian: +1 to pin. also check ECR replication logs — we've seen clock skew in eu-west mirror causing attestations to appear 'older'.

maria: creating immediate hold. release-ops, please hold the release and notify stakeholders. I'll open PR to update release notes and k8s pin.

release-ops: added release hold, notified PM and CS. starting manual rollback of canary to sha256:def456 now. ETA 10m.

kevin: do we need a deploybot hotfix to relax TTL for 1 hour? or better to re-sign? not comfortable changing policy mid-release.

tanvi: prefer re-sign. we have a signing key rotation older than the attestation window — re-signing is safer.

maria: PR #345 opened: "pin prod to stable digest + retag pipeline". I'll run the retag pipeline at 18:30 UTC, then re-run canary once attestations are fresh. Will update this thread with logs.

ian: I'll also diff ECR replication timestamps and post any anomalies here.

release-ops: canary rollback complete, traffic reverted. no user-facing impact reported. keeping hold until retag+verify.

maria: thanks all. postmortem to follow if we see recurrence. action items: 1) retag+re-sign at 18:30 UTC (maria), 2) pin prod digest (tanvi), 3) check replication/clock skew (ian), 4) update release notes & changelog (maria). :white_check_mark:
